notablePrerequisites:
Brago is modified and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Brago.
description:
Declare Brago as an attacker.
Akki Battle Squad triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Akki Battle Squad.
Repeat each combat phase.
